name: @polymarket-bot/strategy-sdk
description: Strategy SDK (WP-170): the pure, versioned Strategy interface (handoff §9.6), the StrategyContext and read-only view contracts (§7.6; ADR-005 §6), and the SeededRandom draw surface. Declarations over the frozen layer-0 domain contracts only — this dependency surface is part of what keeps strategies structurally unable to reach venue/storage adapters (dependency-direction contract F3/F11/F13).
